intro.title: Build scheduler for priority based jobs
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a job scheduler that processes tasks based on their priority levels. You will learn to implement a priority queue using arrays and sorting to manage jobs efficiently. The core programming concepts include array manipulation, conditional logic, and function definitions. You will use fundamental JavaScript constructs like arrays, objects, and loops to create a working scheduler that handles high-priority jobs first.
intro.usecase: Priority-based job schedulers are a core pattern in real-world applications where tasks must be executed in an order of importance, not just first-in-first-out. For example, in a customer support dashboard, incoming tickets are automatically prioritized so that critical issues from premium clients are handled before routine inquiries. As a developer, you might implement this in a video rendering queue, where a user's urgent export jumps ahead of other jobs, or in a notification system that sends real-time alerts before batch updates. Mastering this concept allows you to build efficient, user-centric features that manage limited resources intelligently.
